# Saurav Kanchan

> Software engineer at BlockScholes, building blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts and low-latency data systems. 2× ETHGlobal finalist. Building software professionally since 2019.

Personal site: https://saurav.tech. The page is a client-rendered single-page app; this file carries the same content as plain text.

## Experience

### Software Engineer, BlockScholes (Sep 2024 – Present)

- Replaced a scheduled pipeline with a real-time ingestion server consuming Kinesis streams into DynamoDB, cutting AWS costs by 60%
- Own 5 core smart contracts (Access Control, Data Storage, Derived Data, on-chain SVI, Option Pricing) across 7 chains, powering 8 feed types for Deribit, Bybit, OKX and BlockScholes
- Maintain the transaction sender propagating data to 7 networks every 30 minutes, designed to scale towards per-block updates without significant cost
- End-to-end owner of the Risk Appetite Index: hourly compute pipeline, ~6 years of backfill, served over REST, WebSocket and MCP
- Helped migrate data access from DynamoDB to S3 for a further ~30% cost reduction

### Blockchain Lead, Arcana Network (Oct 2019 – Oct 2024)

- Shipped 10+ smart contracts audited by CertiK and CredShields, deployed across multiple chains
- Built the Go backend for the Arcana dashboard, serving 10K users and 500K monthly requests
- Implemented ERC-4337 and custom access control for gasless transactions and fine-grained permissions
- Architected decentralized storage with read/write performance within 1.2× of traditional web services

### Blockchain Developer, Blocklogy (Apr 2019 – May 2019)

- Built eraswap.life, the gateway to the Era Swap ecosystem
- Worked on the backend of dayswappers.com, Era Swap's referral and affiliate program

### Computer Vision Intern, Mahindra Susten (Jan 2019 – Feb 2019)

- Photovoltaic cell crack detection with Python and OpenCV

## Projects

- [svelte-chartjs](https://github.com/SauravKanchan/svelte-chartjs): Chart.js wrapper for Svelte, used by 1.4K+ projects. (Open source, 2020 – present)
- [NewsAPI](https://github.com/dev3tools/NewsAPI): Unlimited news over GitHub Pages, sidestepping rate limits across 20–25 accounts. Used by 400+ projects. (Open source, 2020 – 2022)
- Multilane: Chain-agnostic assets without traditional bridging: a browser extension that intercepts dApp transactions (e.g. Aave) and a trustless withdrawal mechanism. (ETHGlobal ETHIndia 2023 · top 13 of 480, Dec 2023)
- [Forge Flamegraphs](https://github.com/zemse/forge-flamegraph): Flamegraphs for Solidity to spot gas optimizations; an HTML template rendering graphs generated by a Rust program. (ETHGlobal Scaling Ethereum 2024 · top 8, Apr 2024)
